result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The main visible defect is the top-right profile/notification button, which is an empty gray circle with a lone red dot and no icon. Smaller issues are the low-contrast secondary text and the inconsistent overlay badges on the cards.

issues.description: The circular button at the top right is an empty gray circle with only a small red dot. Its icon (bell, avatar or similar) is missing or failed to load, so its purpose is unclear. The red dot looks like a notification badge floating on nothing.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon (notification bell or profile avatar) inside the button, and anchor the badge to the icon's corner. Add an accessible label.

issues.description: The secondary text (delivery fees under the carousel cards, the search placeholder, and the time, fee and cuisine line) is light gray on a white or light background. Contrast is low and the text is small.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: The white time-pill badges on the carousel cards sit close to the image edge and overlap the plate on the first card. The pill's position looks inconsistent with the '€0 delivery' and '-20%' badges on the large cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge padding, position and style across card types, and make sure the badges don't cover key image content.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons are styled inconsistently. The first has a dark, almost invisible background against the dark ramen image, while the second has a visible translucent circle.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent translucent circular background on the heart buttons so they stay visible on any image.
